title: 1.5.37 Settle It in the Console
description: Two expressions, one pair of brackets, and a question answered in four seconds. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Predict, then log the first expression
steps.instructions: Write your prediction in a comment, then log 2 + 2 * 3.

steps.title: Say what the difference tells you
steps.instructions: In a comment, state the rule the two answers demonstrate.

steps.title: Settle one more of your own
steps.instructions: Log any other expression you were unsure about — a comparison, a string method, a typeof. The point is the habit, not the answer.

requirements.title: The rule is stated in a comment
requirements.description: A comment naming precedence, order of operations, or that multiplication happens first

requirements.title: A third expression of your own
requirements.description: At least three console.log calls, so something beyond the two given was checked
